The break: all six shipped conversions omit `for` (app/_phases/_shared/notebook/notebook.ts:98-105), the fact link the type itself calls uncheckable-by-construction when absent (types.ts:372-375). Consequence: a felt form polished from a low-confidence figure launders it, and no gate can follow the link back to the grade that should cap it.

app/_phases/_shared/notebook/unknowns.ts:1-63 writes each unknown as a prohibition with an impact, scopes it with `about` (:24-31) against the global-hedge failure, and keeps resolved unknowns flagged rather than deleted (:4-7, u-cohorts :40-41, u-liquidity-vendor :54-55) with the index-shift incident named as the reason. Rows are keyed by stable id through UNKNOWN_BY_ID (app/_phases/research/followup.ts:227) and a reference to an unknown the notebook does not carry is REPORTED, never dropped (followup.ts:228-233). Per-render scoring with at-risk/superseded lives one step downstream and is pointed at from unknowns.ts:17-20. The must-say half is typed and honestly declared unpopulated (types.ts:455-459).

Both ladders are modelled well - class including `protected`, interested-is-not-low-confidence, plural FactSource with locator, fact kind, three dates, unit/period/denominator, load-bearing and confidenceNote (app/_phases/_shared/notebook/types.ts:12-138) - and the dangerous combination is flagged at triage (CardTile.tsx:62, :143-147) and in the evidence log (ResearchStep.tsx:297-302). The break is at the surface the ladder names: app/_phases/_shared/notebook/cards.ts:62 carries the @deprecated comma-joined `f.source` (types.ts:82-83) and drops `sources[]`, so app/_phases/research/_parts/CardTile.tsx:137-141 prints a source-shaped blob plus a confidence chip and no evidence-class chip - while pipeline/NOTEBOOK-SCHEMA.md:18 routes `facts[].sources[].evidence_class` to exactly 'the provenance chip at card triage'. Follow-ups reopen the same anti-shape: Effect 'adds-fact' types `source: string` (app/_phases/research/followup.ts:23) and a shipped row semicolon-joins two publications (:63). Consequence: a reviewer cuts an aggregator-sourced fact and a primary-record fact on identical information.

The durable guards the technique prefers are realized - a `primary` rung on the class ladder, three dates, and a locator that makes a claim checkable (app/_phases/_shared/notebook/types.ts:27-33, :62-69, :89-96) - but no machine-provenance state exists anywhere in the contract, and there is no field in which 'not checked' can be recorded distinctly from 'not detected'. The exposure is real rather than theoretical: follow-ups admit new facts sourced to open-web aggregator pages (app/_phases/research/followup.ts:82, :85, :90-94) through an Effect type that carries only a source string (:23). Consequence: a source whose origin was never questioned is indistinguishable at triage from one that was, which is the merge the three-state vocabulary exists to prevent. Lower consequence than the ladder deviation above, and it would be fixed in the same field.
